sources.title: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse is a non-thinking Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 69B total parameters and approximately 3B activated parameters per token. Built on LongCat-Flash-Lite, it replaces dense MLA with LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) and natively supports context lengths of up to 1M tokens.

sources.title: Lightweight MoE LLM Inference - LongCat-Flash-Lite
sources.snippet: Overview LongCat-Flash-Lite is a lightweight Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that explores a new scaling direction: N-gram embedding expansion. Instead of relying primarily on adding more experts, it allocates a large portion of total parameters into an N-gram embedding layer to improve local-context semantic capture, while keeping inference sparse via dynamic activation.

sources.title: Meituan (LongCat) Model: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse ...
sources.snippet: Built on LongCat-Flash-Lite, it replaces dense MLA with LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) and natively supports context lengths of up to 1M tokens. Compared with its dense predecessor, LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse improves long-context inference efficiency and agentic capabilities while preserving strong reasoning and general-knowledge performance.
